workspace.uploadHint: Upload PNG/JPEG/WebP. The image is placed onto the left canvas; the framing box defines the final output.
workspace.framingHint: Whatever falls inside the bright framing box is sent to the AI. Switching the target ratio only resizes the framing box—the image stays put. Drag or scale the image freely.
workspace.modeCropHint: Drag and zoom until the subject fully covers the AI canvas.
workspace.modePadHint: Zoom out to reserve expansion space inside the fixed AI canvas.
